class.name: OcgStandardErrorhandler
class.brief_description: Class implementing mechanics of conversion of signals to exceptions.
class.description: ! Class implementing mechanics of conversion of signals to exceptions. ! ! Each instance of it stores data for jump placement, thread id, ! and callbacks to be called during jump (for proper resource release). ! ! The active handlers are stored in the global stack, which is used ! to find appropriate handler when signal is raised.

method.name: Standard_ErrorHandler
method.description: Create a ErrorHandler (to be used with try{}catch(){}). It uses the "setjmp" and "longjmp" routines.

method.name: Unlink
method.description: Removes handler from the handlers list

method.name: Catches
method.description: Returns "True" if the caught exception has the same type or inherits from "aType"

method.name: IsInTryBlock
method.description: Test if the code is currently running in a try block
